### schedule-nominal

A scheduled workflow's time is nominal; what depends on it tolerates a late or missing run, urgent work is dispatched by hand, and a systems bucket object left unrenewed is younger than T, so through a late run its age, under T + the interval + the worst delay + a job's time, stays under the lifecycle; a dropped or failed run takes it past the lifecycle and rests on R2's deletion window.
